description: A raw answer of @cf/cloudflare/clef to the exact decision request below (buildDecisionRequest for the message of routing case 2). Recorded with a throwaway Worker that passes the request straight to env.AI.run(); that Worker is not part of the repository.

input.message: Camera B is not turning on and I need it for a shoot in 30 minutes!!

state.service: Campus Equipment Booking (projectors, cameras, meeting rooms)

queue.instructions: Which support queue should handle this message sent to the campus equipment booking service?

criteria.booking_change: The sender wants to create, move, extend, shorten or cancel a booking, or reports a booking conflict or double booking
criteria.equipment_fault: The equipment or room facilities are broken, missing, damaged or not working
criteria.access_or_account: The sender cannot log in, is not authorised, or has an account, student ID or permission problem with the booking system
criteria.general_question: A question about rules, availability, policies or how to use the service, or anything that fits no other queue

criteria: Low: no deadline mentioned, can wait several days
Normal: should be handled within one working day
High: the sender is blocked right now or within the next few hours

needs_human.instructions: A staff member must read this message personally before any automatic action is taken, for example because it is ambiguous, a complaint, a safety problem, or fits no queue well.

legend.0: Low: no deadline mentioned, can wait several days
legend.1: Normal: should be handled within one working day
